note: 56x32 preview, 8-colour RGB565 palette, raster run-length: byte = (palette index << 5) | (run - 1). A hand-authored/procedural placeholder (extracted 2026-10-21 from the old player's meter_thumbs.h).
note_roles: palette_roles: per palette entry null (the fixed RGB565 in `palette`), a theme role name (tools/player2/gen_meters_p2.py ROLES) or {"ramp": [roleA, roleB, t, n]} (a + (b - a) * t / n per channel); the firmware resolves them from the active theme each time the preview is drawn, `palette` is the fallback for tools that have no theme.
